operating_camera_center_crosscheck.note: MF camera center vs operating camera_center, not aligned pointing RA/Dec. API and images are not atomic; shared Tetra3 database and different temporal histories mean this is not independent absolute ground truth.

limitations: Overlapping temporal windows are not independent trials.
Exposure arms are chronological; Moon/sky changed over time.
Moon-not-visible capture is a separate condition.
Serial processing timing excludes acquisition, queueing, history age and final publication.
No mount/GoTo or external astrometric ground truth.
Manual scene mask is not deployed or universal.
